title: Value of a parity sign
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The real value of the sign obtained by multiplying the coordinates $x_i$ for $i\in S$ equals the monomial $\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite subset $S$ of the coordinate indices
